acceptance: Scoped final acceptance passed on LG OLED55C3RLA, firmware 43.21.71, using the exact macOS ARM64 CLI and signed Root QA set. Verified signed Root install and rollback, physical and network Home controls, emergency-stop persistence, exact No-root install/reinstall and safe manual-start fallback over root SSH, verified removal and restoration of the original Root profile. Automatic Helper resume with matching group remains fixture evidence. See docs/history/2026-11-13-release-1.20.1-rc2-acceptance.md for package hashes, scope and limitations.
